name: SIX MACHINES
author: swtdr34mz
tagline: A performance drum machine: six machines, four knobs, all sweetspots
description: A performance drum machine in the spirit of the Elektron boxes and the LXR-02: six synthesized machines (KICK, SNARE, TOMS, FM drum and FM cymbals, HATS, CLAP), each with four macro knobs that rest on sweetspots, its own saturation, envelope, LFO and mix. A sequencer of 16 or 32 steps with accents, parameter locks, trig conditions and retrigs; a master with compressor, warmth, tilt, reverb and ping-pong delay; 16 performance pads (beat repeat, tape stop, build-up and drop, throws, kills, freeze, scene morph). MIDI clock, START/STOP and its kick (note 36, ch 10) out over USB: it leads a synth.
credits: Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments).
